theme.description: High-contrast tactical dark background with warm industrial slate & amber accents for warehouse legibility, with smooth light mode toggle for office managers.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase font-heading
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight font-heading
hierarchy.caption: text-xs tracking-wider uppercase font-mono text-muted-foreground

contrast_rules: All standard body text must achieve > 4.5:1 APCA/WCAG AA contrast.
Interactive buttons and status badges must explicit hover text color (e.g., hover:text-white).
Never use pure transparent backgrounds on sticky headers or modals — always use backdrop-blur with bg-black/70 or bg-slate-900/90.

spacing_and_layout.border_padding_rule: Containers with borders MUST contain internal padding (p-4 to p-8) to eliminate text collision.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_mode: MODE B: High Density Grid (Dashboards) & MODE A: Tetris Grid (Mobile Frontline Scanner & Landing)
spacing_and_layout.mobile_touch_targets: Min 48px height (h-12 or h-14) for scanner buttons, barcode triggers, and action approvals on mobile.
spacing_and_layout.alignment_rules: Left align for data tables, lists, and forms. Center align only high-impact hero headings or scanner camera viewfinders.

surface_styles.tracing_beam: 1px glowing amber stroke around priority action cards (e.g., Low Stock Alerts & Approval Needed).
surface_styles.tactical_card: bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-700/80 rounded-lg shadow-sm backdrop-blur-md

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle dark slate grid lines overlay with opacity 0.05 for technical warehouse aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.animations: Framer Motion page transitions, micro-pulse for camera laser scanner line, smooth chart tooltips.

component_strategy.navigation: Sticky top bar + collapsible sidebar with Role Selector (Super Admin, Org Admin, Manager, Worker) & Org Switcher.
shadcn_components: Dialog / Modal for OCR scan preview, CSV upload wizard, and stock adjustment approval
Select & Combobox for Warehouse hierarchy (Warehouse -> Zone -> Aisle -> Rack -> Shelf -> Bin)
Tabs for dashboard views and product detail sections
Badge for stock status (In Stock, Low Stock, Out of Stock, Pending Approval)
custom_components: AI Assistant Drawer / Chat widget (natural language search & voice input trigger)
Webcam Barcode & QR Code scanner overlay with target frame animation
Image Upload & OCR extraction preview box
Audit Log Feed with user avatars & action timestamps

key_screens: Dashboard (KPI Cards, Recharts Inventory Trends, Stock Health, Low Stock Alerts Widget)
AI Assistant Chat ('Ask. Scan. Find. Act.' natural language query & automated execution)
Scan Product (Webcam Barcode Scanner, Image Recognition Upload, Live OCR Text Extractor)
Product Search & Catalog (Filtering, Category, Location Filter, Stock Status)
Product Details (Image, Hierarchical Bin Location, Movement History, Barcode/QR Generator)
Inventory List & Batch Operations (Multi-select adjust, transfer, audit)
Warehouse Hierarchy (Interactive Tree: Org -> Warehouse -> Zone -> Aisle -> Rack -> Shelf -> Bin)
Low Stock Alerts & Reorder Workflow (Threshold settings, automated alert triggers)
Reports & Analytics (Export CSV/PDF, Turn-rate charts, Stockout risk index)
Integrations Wizard (ERP, Shopify, Quickbooks mock syncs)
Users & Roles Management (Multi-tenant org roles: Super Admin, Org Admin, Manager, Worker)
Settings & Audit Logs (Tenant config, webhook triggers, system activity)

warehouse_worker_shelves.description: Worker auditing shelf stock with smart device

warehouse_rack_boxes.description: Industrial cardboard storage boxes on heavy metal rack

warehouse_full_aisle.description: High-bay logistics warehouse aisle with multi-tier storage

testing_attributes.data_testid_rule: Every button, input, tab, card, menu item, and status alert MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure high contrast on dark surfaces: body text must be text-slate-100 or text-slate-200.
Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default HTML select boxes.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for scan confirmations, AI tool calls, and stock adjustments.
Make mobile scanner experience feel native with clear action buttons (Voice, Scan, Upload, AI Ask).
Keep all code cleanly modularized in src/components.
